roflumilast.changes: Added explicit metabolic-interaction categories, mild versus moderate/severe hepatic distinction, pregnancy/labor/lactation precautions and common adverse reactions.
roflumilast.remaining: None for the claims taught. Pigment outcomes are qualified in the source record; no drug-specific pigment response rate inferred from pooled small subgroups.
roflumilast.efficacy: STRATUM week-8 IGA success (clear/almost clear plus >=2-grade improvement) 79.5% active vs 58.0% vehicle; label adjusted difference 20.6 percentage points is CMH-stratified and must not be presented as raw subtraction. No efficacy percentage added to teaching yet.
roflumilast.pigmentSourceFollowup: Read complete STRATUM pigment conference abstract P10.04, CDA 2025, DOI 10.1177/12034754251341249. It reports improvement in both vehicle and active groups, small baseline pigment subgroups, and some new pigment changes. Its aggregate resolution percentages cannot be taught as a drug-specific response rate. No promised pigment clearance or quantitative pigment benefit added.
